title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering. Network-level connectivity service offering (no formal definition provided by the source ontology beyond its class hierarchy position). Subclass of ConnectivityServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ConnectivityServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

publicIpAddressProvisioning.description: Property. Defines how public IP addresses are provided (e.g. Floating: floating IPs are supported). Controlled-vocabulary value (PublicIpAddressProvisioningTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

ipVersion.description: Property. Version of IP address supported (IPv4: only IPv4 addresses are supported; IPv6: both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported). Controlled-vocabulary value (IpVersionTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

tenantSeparation.description: Property. How compute resources of different tenants are separated. Default value: hw-virtualized. Controlled-vocabulary value (TenantSeparation), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
